subject: Fix all remaining SonarCloud issues (24 → 0 target)
body:
Fix all remaining SonarCloud issues (24 → 0 target)

- Convert 20 UI control fields to local variables (S1450)
  in SftpBrowserPanel and SftpBrowserWindow
- Fix redundant disposal by restructuring TryConnect (S3966)
- Fix xterm.js: use _ for unused catch params (S2486),
  use for-of loop (S4138)
- Remove _webView2Environment field, make methods static

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: This commit fixes SonarCloud issues in WebView2/xterm.js SSH terminal and SFTP browser code, which are custom to this fork and absent from our codebase.
